name: framer
description: Use when working with a Framer site programmatically via the Framer Server API — connecting to a project, reading/writing Framer CMS collections, syncing external data in, publishing and deploying, or editing the canvas from a script. Triggers on: Framer, framer-api, Framer CMS, Framer Server API, publish the Framer site, FRAMER_API_KEY.
